verdicts.decision_note: The client leaves the CTA navigation destination unresolved, materially affecting the button's implemented redirect behavior.
The client selects a Facebook account page as the CTA's software-controlled redirect destination; no existing attribute becomes obsolete.
The client supplies the requested Facebook URL that configures the CTA's concrete navigation destination; no prior attribute requires removal.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim that the CTA button was updated after receipt of the Facebook URL; it does not constitute runtime verification.
